== Deletions on Liber Primus Ideas == Hello, you recently removed a theory from the [[Liber_Primus_Ideas_and_Suggestions]] page. While some of us might have doubts about the idea, we generally don't censor ideas that have some merit to them.
Considering that you did not enter a reason for your removal, I've reverted your edit. If you think this is in error and the content should be removed anyway, please enter a good edit summary next time explaining why. Thank you! -- [[User:Crashdemons|Crashdemons]] ([[User talk:Crashdemons|talk]]) 23:13, October 22, 2018 (UTC)
